notes: City of Hebron, FY ended 9/30/2023, accrual statements (GAAP). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (Exhibit E, p6; fund columns p5). Taxes 933,864 split by the fund schedules' printed tax lines (General property 320,034 + motor vehicle 37,435 p12; Street sales 61,118 p15; Recreation property 42,768 + sales 127,377 p21; Economic Development sales 60,000 p26; Sales Tax 261,136 p27; Debt Service property 23,996 p33), ties exactly. Intergovernmental 432,542: homestead 20,292, pro-rate 740 (p12) and MV fee payments 16,664 (p15) split out; remainder 394,846 state aid. Statement Debt service 23,102 split into Debt Service Fund principal 15,000 / interest 8,102 (p33). Other financing (p6): long-term debt proceeds 78,558 (Street loan) -> debt_proceeds; principal (182,353), interest (28,323) and gain on sale of assets 60,000 -> other_financing (printed under other financing sources). Roll-forward: 886,806 + 2,506,117 - 2,656,061 + 469,194 - 469,194 + 78,558 - 150,676 = 664,744. Cash: governmental funds balance sheet p4 (cash in bank, cash on hand, county treasurer, restricted cash) with CDs in the investment fields; beginning from the 2022 comparative column. Business-type: Electric, Water, Sewage Disposal (p14 columns, p15 totals); receipts = operating 822,664 + interest revenue 65,286; expenses 536,005 (p2); 6,639,611 + 887,950 - 536,005 = 6,991,556. Business 'Miscellaneous' 31,967 counted in charges for services because the Statement of Activities charges for services (822,664) equals total operating revenues. Proprietary cash flow p11: ending cash 917,172 vs 'cash balance consists of' 917,257 (report discrepancy 85). Balance sheet from Exhibit A (p1); due to/from other funds 708,331 not eliminated in the Totals column. Cemetery fund spending categorised health/welfare although the report counts it in Culture & recreation (p5 nonmajor 515,902 ties only with cemetery included). Detail: General revenue Sched 2 (p12), General expenditures from the more detailed Sched 2A (p13) (Sched 2 object summary not recorded); Street revenue Sched 4 (p15), expenditures Sched 4A (p16); nonmajor fund schedules 9-20, 22, 24 (all 16 nonmajor funds; schedules tie to the p5 Non-Major column: revenues 1,199,485, expenditures 1,281,182); Electric/Water/Sewer from Sched 29 budgetary-basis totals (p35), the only schedule for them. Sched 28/29 governmental lines not recorded (duplicate the fund schedules). Park/Cemetery/Library Sinking schedules have only zero actuals (capital outlay budget lines recorded). Transfers: in 469,194 = General 126,500 (from Sales Tax) + nonmajor 342,694; out = General 319,591 + Sales Tax 126,500 + Fire Truck Sinking 23,103; all balance. TRIM COVERAGE: the trim holds report pp4-7, 9-10, 12-16, 36-41, 47-61, 63, 68-69. Present and complete: Exhibits A, B, C, E, G (two-page fund/total spreads), H, I, Schedules 2, 2A, 3, 4, 4A, 5, 9-22, 24, 28, 29. Not in the trim (schedule numbering gaps): Schedule 1 (before report p36), Schedules 6-8 (report pp42-46), Schedule 23 (report p62), Schedules 25-27 (report pp64-67, likely Electric/Water/Sewer detail), plus report pp8 and 11 (likely reconciliation pages).
